title: Solutions Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Function**

Product Marketing

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

**Job description**
===================

**About the Role**

Hitachi Vantara’s customers run mission-critical workloads for Fortune 500 enterprises, government agencies, financial institutions, healthcare systems, and critical infrastructure operators. When their business applications and databases are slow, expensive, non-compliant, or unavailable, the consequences are not IT consequences. They are board-level, and in some cases public-safety, consequences.

This role owns the go-to-market for the solutions that help enterprises modernize and manage critical business applications and databases, improve cost and operational performance, strengthen resilience and continuity, and meet compliance obligations they increasingly have to prove rather than assert.

The work itself is translation under pressure. You take genuinely complex technology and turn it into a clear market story, a differentiated solution narrative, and practical tools a seller can use in a live customer conversation. Done well, it changes what the field leads with, how partners position us, and which conversations we get invited into.

**Structure and scope.** You report into product marketing leadership and own strategy and execution for the Business Applications & Databases domain. You will also execute established plans and priority solution plays across Data & Cyber Resilience and Virtualization & Cloud, alongside the teammates who own those domains. That cross-domain exposure is deliberate; it is how a strong product marketer becomes a go-to-market leader.

**Who this fits.** A product marketer with global enterprise B2B experience, strong analytical instincts, and the confidence to work across product, sales, technical, partner, and marketing teams without waiting to be told what to do next. It fits best if you are the person who asks why we position it that way, goes and gets the customer, analyst, and competitive evidence, and comes back with a better answer — then does it again a quarter later, when the market has moved. Positioning has a shelf life. We are not looking for someone to maintain the current narrative. We are looking for someone to keep sharpening it.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Domain go-to-market.** Strategy and execution for Business Applications & Databases: positioning, messaging, target audiences, buyer needs, and the solution narrative. This is yours to define, not to inherit.
* **Value propositions that hold up.** Translate solution strategy and technical capability into differentiated, outcome-led stories that survive contact with enterprise buyers, sellers, and partners.
* **Customer-facing assets that get used.** Solution pages, solution profiles, data sheets, sales presentations, and sales tools — accurate, differentiated, and built for how buyers actually evaluate.
* **Sales and partner enablement.** Assets and readiness that support the buyer journey from awareness through purchase, strengthen field readiness, and activate partners.
* **Cross-domain execution.** Established go-to-market plans and priority solution plays across Data & Cyber Resilience and Virtualization & Cloud.
* **Cross-functional alignment.** Work with product, sales, technical, partner, and marketing teams across messaging, content, enablement, campaigns, launches, and solution plays.
* **The evidence base.** Gather and synthesize customer, market, competitive, analyst, and field input — then use it to sharpen differentiation, validate technical accuracy, and challenge positions that the evidence no longer supports.
* **Delivery at pace.** Multiple deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and shifting priorities, held to a high bar for quality, consistency, and timeliness.

**Why This Role**

* **You own something real.** You will make calls that show up in how a global portfolio goes to market.
* **You can change how we do things.** Bring a case built on customer, analyst, and competitive evidence and you will get a hearing, whatever the current answer is. The fastest way to earn influence here is to bring the evidence that moves a position forward.
* **You build the skill set the market is paying for.** Exponential data infrastructure, cloud, AI, and cyber resilience are the categories enterprise buyers are funding, and the ones product marketers are being recruited for. You will develop that fluency here, on real solutions, with real customers.
* **Your work reaches buyers whose decisions matter.** Regulated industries, mission-critical workloads, and multi-stakeholder buying committees. Sharper positioning, harder proof, higher standard.
* **You get coached, not just managed.** You will work directly with product marketing leaders who will push your thinking, review your work seriously, and give you the exposure that builds a go-to-market leader.
* **There is a path.** This role is scoped to grow into broader go-to-market leadership. We hire people we expect to outgrow the job description.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in product marketing, solutions marketing, product management, technical marketing, or enterprise B2B technology marketing.
* Experience owning or supporting go-to-market strategy and execution — solution launches, campaigns, sales plays, or related commercialization work.
* Proven ability to translate complex technical capability into clear positioning, messaging, value propositions, and customer-facing content.
* Experience building solution-oriented assets and enablement materials: web pages, solution briefs, data sheets, sales presentations, and sales tools.
* Experience supporting sales enablement, partner marketing, channel enablement, or field-readiness programs.
* Experience in a global enterprise technology environment, or supporting complex, multi-stakeholder B2B buying cycles.
* Strong analytical skills. You can read a market, interrogate customer, analyst, and competitive input, and build an evidence-backed case for a position.
* Strong writing and editing, with the judgment to know when a claim needs a proof point behind it.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate across product, sales, technical, partner, and marketing stakeholders.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience marketing to enterprise technology buyers and influencers across workload, application, or database modernization.
* Familiarity with hybrid cloud, data infrastructure, enterprise data management, data protection, cybersecurity, or governance risk and compliance.
* Experience developing narratives or programs for highly regulated industries.
* Fluency with AI and LLM tools to accelerate research, content development, analysis, and go-to-market workflows.

As required by the equal pay and transparency acts, the expected base salary for this position is: $110K to $120K. The expected on-target earnings for this position is: $123K to $134K.

The expected pay is determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience in the practice area. Employees are eligible to participate in Hitachi Vantara’s bonus/variable/commission pay programs, where applicable, and are subject to the program’s conditions and restrictions.

title: S4 Product Owner Innovation to Order
description:
S4 Product Owner Innovation to Order

We have an opportunity for an **S4 Product Owner** to join us at Honeywell, in Atlanta or Charlotte, where you will be responsible for translating the S4 product vision and roadmap into actionable backlog items for your designated functional area. You will own, manage, and prioritize the Team Backlog, ensuring user stories, defects, and enablers are clearly defined, ordered by business value, and ready for delivery by the Agile team.

You will work closely with the S4 Product Manager, business stakeholders, process owners, and delivery teams to ensure the team understands business priorities, customer needs, and functional requirements.

  

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
* 3+ years of experience working as Project Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in an Agile delivery environment.
* 3+ years of strong knowledge of ERP systems, particularly SAP S4, and innovation to order processes.
* 3+ years of experience with Jira managing backlogs, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting Agile team execution.
* 3+ years of experience with the ability to translate business needs into clear functional requirements for technical and delivery teams.
* 3+ years if experience with strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across business, IT, and delivery teams.
Ability to travel up to 20%  

**WE VALUE**

* Advanced degrees in Engineering, or related field.
* Candidates with hands-on experience following the SAFe methodology.
* 3+ years of experience in innovation to order, material management, New Product introduction, ERP implementation, or related role.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making skills, and ability to drive execution discipline
* Ability to manage competing priorities and make backlog decisions based on business value and delivery impact.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain functional requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.  

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

The Corporate Strategic Business Group (CORP SBG) at Honeywell is a division focused on corporate-level functions and initiatives that support the overall operations and strategy of the company. It is responsible for overseeing areas such as finance, legal, human resources, communications, and corporate governance, working closely with other business units and SBGs to ensure alignment and coordination across the organization. The CORP SBG plays a crucial role in the overall strategic direction and management of Honeywell's corporate functions and operations, supporting the company's business objectives.

Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. title: Aftermarket & Product Intelligence Manager
description:
**Date:** Sep 17, 2026

  

**Location:** Renton, WA, US, 98055

  

**Company:** PACCAR

  

PACCAR Parts is seeking a strategic, skilled manager to lead a team responsible for advancing product data quality and market intelligence. This role combines people leadership with program execution to support parts sales by improving product cross-references, attributes, digital assets, data mapping, and systems integration.

  

The manager will lead cross-functional initiatives, establish and enforce data standards, resolve data quality issues, and deliver measurable business results. Using tools such as Python, Snowflake, Tableau, and generative AI, this role will monitor product data health and provide actionable insights into industry trends, competitive activity, and market positioning.

**Job Functions / Responsibilities**

* Leads Product Information Management (PIM) system ownership, including product data lifecycle management, system enhancements, and data quality.
* Develops and maintains the Product Data Standards Guide, defining requirements for launching parts on e-commerce sites, formatting product data, and ensuring data completeness.
* Embeds SEO best practices into data governance rules by establishing and enforcing naming conventions and keyword requirements that maximize search discoverability.
* Collaborates with Product Marketing teams and suppliers to improve product data quality.
* Creates, monitors, and enforces data quality audits to proactively identify inconsistencies and ensure compliance with established standards.
* Monitors data health dashboards to assess completeness and accuracy, prioritizing remediation efforts and enhancements based on findings.
* Serves as the final quality gatekeeper for product data, providing analysts with specific feedback to correct errors at the source before publication.
* Develops and leverages generative AI to create data visualizations, executive summaries, dashboards, and infographics that provide sales and marketing leaders with actionable market insights.
* Monitors industry news and collaborates with global partners to maintain accurate PACCAR competitive analyses.
* Leads process improvement initiatives across product data management and market intelligence.
* Leads, coaches, and develops a team of product and market data professionals by establishing priorities, assigning resources, managing performance, and fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 7 Years of relevant work experience required.
* Previous supervision or management expereince required.
* Demonstrated experience managing product data lifecycles within a Product Information Management (PIM) or similar system.
* Proven track record of designing and executing data quality audits and establishing data governance frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL and experience using Snowflake to query, transform, and validate large data sets, automate workflows, and streamline quality-control processes.
* Ability to build and interpret Tableau dashboards to monitor, analyze, and report data health metrics.
* Strong understanding of SEO principles, including applying keyword strategies to product titles and attribute structures.
* Strong experience analyzing market trends, competitive landscapes, and key business drivers to inform business strategy.
* Proven ability to synthesize complex data sets into clear, actionable executive summaries and presentations.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical insights to non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented, cross-functional business environment.
* Able to travel up to 15%
  

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Python libraries, such as Pandas, for complex data manipulation.
* Familiarity with regular expressions (Regex) for pattern matching and complex data validation.
* Experience using machine learning or generative AI tools for content generation, data standardization, or attribute enrichment.
  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related technical field required
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related field preferred
  

**Competencies**

* Act with Integrity
* Demonstrate Adaptability
* Drive for Results
* Influence Others
* Lead Innovation and Quality Initiatives
* Manage Execution
* Manage Talent
* Use Sound Judgment / Business Acumen
  

**PACCAR Benefits:**

* As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you have a full range of benefit options including:
* 401k with up to a 5% company match
* Fully funded pension plan that provides monthly benefits after retirement
* Comprehensive paid time off - minimum of 10 paid vacation days (additional days with additional seniority/years of service), 12 paid holidays, and sick time
* Tuition reimbursement for continued education
* Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
* Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
* Paid short and long-term disability programs
* Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
* EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
* This position is eligible for an annual holiday gift
* This position may offer relocation assistance benefits

**Salary Range:**  
  
At PACCAR, we value talent and promote growth and development. We carefully consider numerous compensation factors including your education, training, or experience. The salary range for this position is $119,100.00 - $168,300.00 annually. Additionally, this role is eligible for the full range of benefit options listed above.

**Additional Information:**

* PACCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability.
* PACCAR Parts is an E-Verify Employer
* PACCAR has success with diverse teams of employees working together to achieve excellent results. Having a diverse and inclusive work environment ensures PACCAR has the talent needed to conduct business today and in the future by leveraging different backgrounds, skills, and viewpoints. We believe diversity in the workplace increases innovation, results in better decisions and increases employee engagement.
  

**Division Information**  
  
PACCAR Parts is the global provider of aftermarket parts and services to support Kenworth, Peterbilt, DAF and TRP dealers around the world. This includes 21 distribution centers globally that support 2,300 dealerships and over 1,000,000 customers. Aftermarket support includes world class customer centers that deliver industry leading uptime in conjunction with our outstanding supply chain that delivers record levels of inventory availability for dealers and customers.
  
  
**Company Information**  
  
PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905. PACCAR Inc is recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle, financial, and customer service fields with internationally recognized brands such as Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of premium light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates and also provides customized financial services, information technology and truck parts related to its principal business.
  
  
Whether you want to design the transportation technology of tomorrow, support the staff functions of a dynamic, international leader, or build our excellent products and services, you can develop the career you desire with PACCAR. Get started!

  

**Nearest Major Market:** Seattle
  
**Nearest Secondary Market:** Bellevue
  
**Job Segment:** Supply Chain Manager, Marketing Manager, Machinist, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Operations, Marketing, Manufacturing, Technology

description:
**Job Description**

**Hybrid.** This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren, Michigan three times per week, at minimum or other frequency dictated by the business.

**The Role**

General Motors is seeking a Manager, Product Research - Product Experience Clinics & KPIs to lead a team of researchers and/or analysts within Global Customer Research (GCR) Product Research. This leader will bring the voice of the customer into GM’s vehicle software, digital experiences, features, and emerging technologies.

The Manager partners with Program Management and Software Product teams to understand and anticipate customer needs, vehicle-usage contexts, and experience opportunities in, on, and around the vehicle. The role supports the development of planned customer experiences—software-orchestrated coordination of vehicle features—that meet customer needs and exceed expectations, enabling meaningful innovation and industry-leading CX/UX.

This role is ideal for a customer-centered research leader who combines strong project execution and people leadership with the ability to turn complex customer learning into clear product direction. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted research partner to stakeholders, guide a portfolio of bespoke research, and develop a capable team that delivers rigorous, timely, and actionable insight.

**What You’ll Do**

**Partner with product and program teams**

* Build trusted working relationships with Program Management and Software Product stakeholders; understand their priorities, decision timelines, and customer-learning needs.
* Translate stakeholder priorities into research plans aligned to product-development milestones and the broader GCR research roadmap.
* Lead framing conversations that clarify the business decision, target customer, learning objectives, scope, success measures, and intended use of findings.
* Partner with stakeholders to develop dual-use stimuli that support internal decision-making and customer research, creating a clear connection between product intent and customer feedback.
* Represent the customer perspective in cross-functional forums and provide a clear, evidence-based point of view.

**Lead customer research that informs product decisions**

* Plan, design, and execute bespoke qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method research that provides timely, actionable insight for Software Product and Program Management partners.
* Lead foundational, benchmarking, and contextual research to inform product requirements, experience design, feature prioritization, usability evaluation, validation, and launch readiness.
* Plan and execute pre-launch confirmatory and market-assurance experience studies; identify opportunities to improve user experiences before late-stage decisions are fixed.
* Select appropriate approaches, including interviews, ethnography, usability testing, in-vehicle evaluation, journey research, concept and feature testing, surveys, and competitive benchmarking.
* Translate learning into concise, decision-ready deliverables that clearly communicate customer needs, implications, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Ensure read-across analyses are completed when opportunities exist to synthesize learning across studies, customer themes, product areas, or technology domains.

**Lead people, projects, and resources**

* Directly lead, coach, and develop researchers and/or analysts; set clear goals and expectations, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
* Build a high-performance culture characterized by customer focus, intellectual curiosity, collaboration, accountability, constructive challenge, and continuous improvement.
* Manage an assigned portfolio, including priorities, work plans, milestones, budget, supplier support, and stakeholder expectations.
* Direct study materials, suppliers, logistics, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder follow-through to meet agreed scope, timing, quality, and budget expectations.
* Provide clear status communication to leadership and stakeholders; surface material risks, scope changes, trade-offs, and resource needs early.
* Manage research suppliers, budgets, schedules, tools, and facilities in accordance with GM processes and policies.

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of vehicle or product-development processes and the role of customer research in product and program decision-making.
* Experience leading primary research projects or serving as a primary stakeholder for primary research, from framing through application of findings.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including setting goals, coaching, and developing team members.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, schedules, and stakeholders in a complex, changing environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, concise, and actionable research deliverables.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and persuasion skills; able to communicate effectively with technical, business, program, and leadership audiences.
* Proficiency using AI-enabled tools to improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of research and day-to-day work.
* High degree of creativity, resourcefulness, and sound critical thinking, with strong problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Software product development experience.
* Post-graduate degree.
* Direct market research experience across quantitative and qualitative methodologies.
* Experience in automotive, mobility, connected services, consumer technology, digital products, or other complex hardware-software ecosystems.
* Experience conducting UX research related to in-vehicle experiences, human-machine interfaces, connected services, or emerging vehicle technologies.

title: Product Owner / Business Analyst (Remote Opportunity)
description:
Mind Computing is seeking a fulltime, 100% remote **Product Owner / Business Analyst** to support a project with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and Agile delivery teams, translating business objectives and federal requirements into actionable product direction. This role will focus on product backlog management, user story development, stakeholder collaboration, and Agile delivery, with an emphasis on federal healthcare workflows, EDI transactions, interoperability standards, and SAFe/Agile methodologies while ensuring solutions meet security, accessibility, and compliance requirements.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Establish and maintain a product vision and roadmap aligned with agency mission, strategic objectives, and federal requirements.
* Translate federal healthcare priorities, policies, and modernization initiatives into actionable product and backlog items (e.g., MISSION Act, VA Modernization, Interoperability Rules).
* Ensure product direction aligns with enterprise architecture, data governance, and interoperability standards.
* Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, compliance requirements, stakeholder priorities, and urgency.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria reflecting complex federal healthcare workflows, including referrals, scheduling, RFS, and EDI transactions.
* Ensure backlog items meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done requirements, including security and accessibility considerations.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business owners, SMEs, clinical stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate communication across business and technical teams.
* Ensure product features and releases comply with HIPAA, Section 508 accessibility requirements, and agency specific security controls.
* Coordinate with teams supporting related products and systems across the enterprise portfolio.
* Ensure product capabilities support healthcare interoperability standards and workflows, including HL7, FHIR, and EDI 278/275/217 transactions.
* Lead and participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release planning.
* Review completed functionality against acceptance criteria and business requirements prior to release.
* Coordinate with development, testing, security, and change management teams to ensure releases are fully tested, documented, and approved.
* Identify opportunities to improve access to services, reduce administrative burden, and enhance overall service delivery.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years of professional analyst experience.
* Demonstrated experience working as a Product Owner and/or Business Analyst within Agile delivery environments.
* Strong experience with SAFe/Agile methodologies, including backlog management, user story development, refinement, sprint planning, and release planning.
* Demonstrated expertise with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transactions, including hands on experience analyzing, interpreting, and validating EDI data within complex enterprise workflows.
* Strong understanding of software development and product delivery processes, including requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex business challenges and develop effective solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate across multiple stakeholders and delivery teams.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Experience with SAFe/Agile.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification preferred.
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal/government agencies.
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, EDI 278/275/217, and healthcare integration workflows.
* Experience working with HIPAA, Section 508, federal security controls, and government compliance requirements.
* Ability to obtain government clearance.

**Benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision
* PTO + Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training opportunities
* 401(k) with employer match
* Remote work options

**Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.**

Mind Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

At this time, we are unable to offer sponsorship.
